sections.title: Before booking in Boise
sections.html:
For a 30-minute booking, pick one decision to solve. Bring two tops you already wear and a photograph of the item you keep returning. Ask the analyst to explain the difference between those choices before discussing a whole new wardrobe. If you want closet editing or a detailed shopping list, request that scope separately so the short appointment does not become an expensive introduction.

  • Can the 30-minute appointment cover my specific purchase?
  • Does the quoted service include a physical swatch and follow-up questions?

sections.title: Make the result useful in your everyday wardrobe
sections.html: Use your first week to compare one suggested color against an existing favorite. Keep the garment, lighting and makeup consistent, and judge whether you actually like wearing it. A digital palette can accompany that experiment, while the physical swatch gives you something to hold beside fabric. Neither requires replacing every black, white or beige item you own.
